title: AgentIntegration v1alpha1
description: Yashigani ring-fence onboarding manifest (v2.25.0 P1). External $ref resolution is DISABLED — this schema is self-contained. Do not add external $ref entries.

name.description: Agent name — lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens; min 3, max 64 chars.

tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier — same character set as name. Must not contain NUL or newlines. The parser additionally asserts that the resolved KMS prefix equals /tenant/<tenant_id>/.

description.description: Human-readable description of this agent integration (used by DISCLOSURE.md generator — G7).

category.description: Agent category — drives codegen template selection.

upstream.description: Upstream project URL (for GDPR sub-processor inventory).

digest.description: SHA-256 image digest (required — M6). Must be sha256:<64 hex chars>.

provider.description: LLM provider. Used to populate Caddy egress routes (L2).

base_url.description: Provider base URL. Codegen hardcodes this — never sourced from request headers (C1).

identity_propagation.description: Identity propagation mode. gateway-signed-jwt: ES384 JWT in _meta (Nico NICO-004) — v1 default. per-user-credential: per-user credential forwarding — v1. gateway-enforced-only: FORBIDDEN for CONFIDENTIAL/RESTRICTED sensitivity ceiling (linter P2 rejects). Default: gateway-signed-jwt.

pin_mode.description: Upstream pin mode (P8). cert_fingerprint is v1 default.

server_allowlist.description: Allowlist of server IDs this agent may consume. Replaces tool_allowlist (Iris L-02).

session_mode.description: MCP session mode. persistent = long-lived stdio subprocess (Shape-C / L-05). stateless = HTTP only.

transport.description: MCP transport. stdio = Shape-C subprocess channel; streamable_http = Shape-B HTTP listener.

shim_port.description: v4.1 Phase 1b-i: port of the first-party Streamable-HTTP shim on the MCP's ringfence bridge (the wrap's reverse_proxy upstream). Bridge-local only - never published.

mesh_port.description: v4.1 Phase 1b-i: pinned Caddy mesh-listener port for this MCP's per-instance front. Optional - defaults to the deterministic 9500 + sha256(tenant/name) % 400 assignment (codegen _mcp_mesh_port).

listen_port.description: Port the agent exposes for MCP (mcp-b/mcp-c HTTP only). null for stdio shape (Shape-C has no network listener).

max_depth_arg.description: OPA enforces directory_tree maxDepth <= this value.

max_pattern_len_arg.description: OPA enforces search_files pattern length <= this value.

tools.description: Tool names/objects this agent exposes (P9 per-tool OPA authz). String form = allowed:true with no caps. Object form allows explicit allowed/denied tools and per-tool OPA constraints.

inbound_ports.description: Inbound ports — only 1024-49151 allowed (M5). Non-MCP inbound is forbidden in v1; use mcp.exposes.listen_port instead.

host.description: Egress-allowed hostname. Must not be an RFC1918/loopback/link-local address (C1 codegen rejects those). Hardcoded string — never sourced from request headers.

justification.description: Required for CONFIDENTIAL/RESTRICTED ceiling agents (G3 covert-channel control).

ingress.description: v4.1 unified-sidecar (design §2.1) — what the system SERVES. Phase 2a consumes shim_port (the intra-zone-deny tuple for the egress-forwarder split-ringfence topology); surface classes generalise in the descriptor-unification phase. For Shape-C MCPs, spec.mcp.exposes.shim_port remains authoritative when both are absent/present per codegen._resolve_shim_port precedence (ingress.shim_port wins).

shim_port.description: The system's serve/shim port. Pins the intra-zone deny: forwarder → system:<shim_port> is DENIED on the egress ringfence (design §2.3).

egress.description: v4.1 unified-sidecar Phase 1 (design §2.1) — declared egress destination classes. Each needs[] entry declares ONE egress prefix this system may traverse via /egress/eval/{prefix}/*. The approve transaction writes the (caller SPIFFE, prefixes) OPA grant from EXACTLY this list (positive-grant, closed-world — Lu M1): omitting this block (or declaring needs: []) grants NO egress. deliver_to/pins are consumed by the sidecar template codegen (later phase); only prefix is consumed by the grant write.

prefix.description: Egress prefix slug (lowercase alnum + hyphen, max 64). Becomes the first-class OPA input.egress.prefix and a member of the caller's grant set. Slug-constrained so it can never carry path metacharacters into deliver_path construction (L-US-4 adjacent).

deliver_to.description: Final delivery destination (public host[:port], or a reserved class name for internal delivery, e.g. gateway-inference for the llm class). Consumed by the sidecar template codegen — NOT by the grant write.

pins.description: Destination/account pins (bot-token workspace pin, webhook path pin, bot-ID pin, …). Consumed by the sidecar template codegen; the template FAILS render for internet-facing/webhook prefixes without their pin (Laura L-US-3 — enforced by codegen._assert_egress_pins, Phase 2a).

svid_files.description: TRANSITIONAL (v4.1 Phase 2a — retires at the system's per-instance /agents/ identity migration, design §3.1 step 1). Pre-migration bundled systems (openclaw) hold a hand-minted service leaf as per-file host binds instead of the standard SVID named volume. Declaring this block makes the egress-forwarder mount these files READ-ONLY at the standard SVID container paths, so the generated forwarder config is identical across modes. Declarative capability config — codegen has NO name-keyed branch.

cert.description: Host path (compose-relative) of the service leaf certificate, e.g. ./secrets/openclaw_client.crt.

key.description: Host path of the service leaf private key. The forwarder container runs as owner_uid so it can read the 0600 key.

ca.description: Host path of the trust anchor used to verify the caddy:18790 egress-gateway server certificate (e.g. ./secrets/ca_root.crt — the same anchor the system itself uses today).

owner_uid.description: Owning UID of the key file; the forwarder container user is set to this UID (transitional-mode replacement for the GID-2003 volume contract).

override_id.description: Optional override for the SPIFFE URI suffix. Validator enforces the /agents/{tenant_id}/{name} prefix (N1).

source.description: Only KMS-sourced secrets are supported in v1.

env.description: Environment variable NAME pointing at the file path. Never the value itself (S9).

kms_path.description: KMS logical key path. Must start with /tenant/<tenant_id>/ (M2 KMS-prefix assertion).

write_posture.description: Shape-C MCP-server write posture. readonly (default): write/move tools denied by OPA. readwrite: operator explicitly enables mutating tools. Requires Laura sign-off per feedback_laura_review_new_third_party_components.

subprocess.description: Shape-C stdio subprocess invocation spec. All args hardcoded by codegen — no operator-supplied field reaches subprocess argv unquoted (M3).

command.description: Subprocess argv[0..n-1]. Hardcoded at codegen time from manifest fields only.

args.description: Additional argv entries appended after command. Codegen validates all entries before emitting.

mounts.description: Shape-C named-volume mounts. hostPath is BLOCKED in v1 (Laura LAURA-FS-TM-002). Each entry must use type=volume with a tenant-namespaced name.

name.description: Volume name. Must follow tenant-namespace pattern enforced by linter.

type.description: Only 'volume' (named Docker volume) is permitted in v1. hostPath requires a separate Laura review (v2).

container_path.description: Container-side mount path. Must not be /, /etc, /run, /run/secrets, /var, /opt (linter enforces).

read_only.description: If true, mount is read-only inside the container.

create_if_missing.description: If true, codegen emits a volume definition so Docker creates it on first run.

tmpfs.description: tmpfs overlays for Shape-C containers (e.g. /tmp for Node.js runtime — keeps root FS read-only).

path.description: Mount path for the tmpfs overlay.

size_limit.description: Size limit (e.g. '64m'). Passed as tmpfs-size to compose/Helm.

mode.description: v1 only supports persistent mode. on-demand is v2 (Nico NICO-003 — on-demand issuance blocked on PKI Issuer API).

session_mode.description: Session persistence mode. stdio = gateway runs the subprocess (L-05, Tiago-locked stdio day-1). stateless = HTTP only.

container_per.description: Isolation level. identity = per-user container (L11 Pool Manager).

items.description: Subset of ring-fence event types to capture for this agent. Maps to the 10 registered EventType values (W0a).

sensitivity_ceiling.description: Maximum data sensitivity this agent may process. Global default is CONFIDENTIAL (Iris L-01 removes per-agent sensitivity_ceiling from v1 spec; ceiling is set globally).

annex_iii_category.description: Optional EU AI Act Annex III risk category (informational — Nico N8).

signature.description: Manifest signature provenance (M7). Populated by the signing ceremony; present in registered manifests.

algorithm.description: cosign-bundled-key = non-FIPS air-gap path; rsa-pss-3072-sha384 = FIPS path (Nico NICO-005, OpenSSL FIPS Provider CMVP #4985).

signature_hex.description: Hex-encoded signature. For cosign path, base64url of the cosign bundle; for RSA-PSS path, hex of the DER signature.

signed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the manifest was signed.

signer_key_id.description: Key identifier (e.g. bundled cosign pub key fingerprint, or RSA key ID from KMS).
